name: When can plumbing and sink fixtures be hooked up after countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: When can plumbing and sink fixtures be hooked up after countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing work should be disconnected before old counters are removed and reconnected only after the new countertops and undermount sink have fully cured. Undermount sinks require silicone and mechanical supports that must set for at least 24 hours before bearing the weight of water or garbage disposals. Having a licensed plumber connect your faucet, disposal, and drain lines the day after installation prevents leaks and protects your warranty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wait at least 24 hours after countertop installation before reconnecting plumbing to allow adhesives, silicone, and sink mounting clips to cure completely.
